captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a realistic triple-fan graphics card (GPU) designed with a sleek, dark industrial aesthetic. It features a long, rectangular matte-black shroud enclosing three detailed axial fans, each with curved blades and a central hexagonal hub. Underneath the shroud, a metallic silver heatsink structure is visible along the sides, paired with a thin circuit board base and an I/O bracket at one end. The three cooling fans are designed to rotate continuously around their central axes for realistic cooling animation.
captions.instruction: Generate a detailed 3D model of a high-performance graphics card with a matte black shroud, a silver heatsink block, and three cooling fans. The fans should be set up as continuous rotational joints so they can spin realistically.
captions.factory: The graphics card is built as an ArticulatedObject. First, the main body (GPU shroud, PCB base, and metallic heatsink blocks) is constructed using Box primitives, combined and colored with dark grey, silver, and gold-accented materials. Next, three identical fan assemblies are created, each consisting of a central hexagonal hub (using a Cylinder or extruded polygon) and multiple curved blades. These fans are positioned linearly along the card's body and connected to the main body using continuous articulations (revolute joints) centered at their respective coordinates.
